_about: Public-domain John Gibson Paton (1824-1907, Presbyterian missionary to the New Hebrides) for the Word Hoard: John G. Paton, Missionary to the New Hebrides: an Autobiography, edited by his brother James Paton, Parts I and II (London, 1889) and vol. III (New York: Revell, 1898), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

paton-autobiography-1: John G. Paton, Missionary to the New Hebrides, part first, ed. by his brother (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MDCCCLXXXIX)
paton-autobiography-2: John G. Paton, Missionary to the New Hebrides, second part, ed. by his brother (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MDCCCLXXXIX)
paton-autobiography-3: John G. Paton, Missionary to the New Hebrides: an Autobiography, vol. III, ed. by his brother (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1898)

_alternates.paton-copies: Later Hodder editions (1890-1891), the Carter and Revell issues, and PG 71542, 75800, 74994

_excluded.paton-story: The Story of John G. Paton (PG 28025), James Paton's retelling for the young; modern reprints
